(Munich, Germany) | college = [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado]] (2020–2024) | draft_year = 2024 | draft_round = 1 | draft_pick = 18 | draft_team = [[Orlando Magic]] | career_start = 2024 | years1 = {{nbay|2024|start}}–present | team1 = [[Orlando Magic]] | years2 = 2025-present | highlights = * First-team [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] ([[2022–23 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|2023]]) * Second-team [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] (2024) | medaltemplates = {{MedalSport|Men's basketball}} {{MedalCountry|{{bk|GER}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[EuroBasket]]}} {{MedalGold|[[EuroBasket 2025|2025 Cyprus–Finland–Poland–Latvia]]|}} }} '''Tristan da Silva''' (born 15 May 2001) is a Brazilian-German professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Orlando Magic]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado Buffaloes]]. ==Early life== Da Silva was born and raised in [[Munich]], Germany to a Brazilian father and a German mother.{{cite web|url=https://coloradobuffaloeswire.usatoday.com/lists/colorado-mens-basketball-2023-24-player-profile-tristan-da-silva-buffs/|title=Colorado men's basketball 2023-24 player profile: Tristan da Silva|first=Tony|last=Cosolo|website=Colorado Buffaloes Wire|publisher=[[USA Today]]|date=19 October 2023|access-date=21 November 2023}} In 2019, he played simultaneously with Schwabing, in Germany's Regionalliga, and IBA München (International Basketball Academy, Munich), in the NBBL. In 12 games with IBA München, da Silva led the team in scoring at 16.9 points per game while shooting 53.2 percent. Da Silva committed to playing college basketball in the United States for [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado]] in the midst of [[COVID-19]].{{Cite web |last=Rooney |first=Pat |date=15 April 2020 |title=CU basketball finalizes 2020 spring recruiting class with Tristan da Silva |url=https://www.denverpost.com/2020/04/15/cu-basketball-finalizes-2020-spring-recruiting-class-with-tristan-da-silva/ |access-date=18 November 2023 |website=[[The Denver Post]]}} ==College career== Da Silva played in 24 games and averaged 2.7 points and one rebound per game during his [[freshman]] season at Colorado.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/Article/Already-needed-to-step-up-Tristan-da-Silva-looks-to-do-so-again-173020575/|title=Already needed to step up, Tristan da Silva looks to do so again|first=Jake|last=Shapiro|website=[[247Sports]]|date=14 October 2021|access-date=18 November 2023}} He became a starter going into his [[sophomore]] season and averaged 9.4 points and 3.5 rebounds over 31 games played.{{cite web|url=https://www.cbsnews.com/colorado/news/tristan-da-silva-colorado-buffaloes-leader-basketball/|title=Tristan Da Silva counted on even more to step up as Colorado Buffaloes basketball leader|website=[[CBS Colorado]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=20 October 2022|access-date=18 November 2023}} Da Silva was named first-team [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] as a junior after averaging 15.9 points, 4.8 rebounds, and 1.3 steals per game.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/37767915/tristan-da-silva-extra-year-colorado-aid-draft-future|title=Tristan da Silva: Extra year at Colorado to aid draft future|first=Jonathan|last=Givony|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=31 May 2023|access-date=18 November 2023}} In 2023, Da Silva registered his name for the [[NBA draft]], but ended up returning to Colorado for his senior season. In his final season at Colorado, Da Silva averaged 16.0 points, 5.1 rebounds, and 2.4 assists per game, while shooting a career high 39.5% from 3 on 4.8 attempts a game. He was named second-team All-Pac-12.{{Cite web |title=Tristan Da Silva College Stats |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/tristan-dasilva-1.html |access-date=2024-06-29 |website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com |language=en}} Despite having remaining college eligibility, Da Silva declared for the [[NBA draft]] on April 29, 2024.{{Cite web |last=Grubbs |first=Grant |date=2024-04-29 |title=Tristan Da Silva makes decision on future at Colorado, 2024 NBA Draft |url=https://www.on3.com/pro/news/colorado-forward-tristan-da-silva-declares-for-2024-nba-draft/
